data.summary: Regulatory Reporting professional with 4.5+ years of experience supporting regulatory reporting, reporting analysis, data validation, exception management and stakeholder coordination within financial services. Experienced in MiFID II, Solvency II, PRIIPs, SFDR, MMF and AIFMD reporting processes, with strong exposure to regulatory data quality, reporting issue investigation and timely resolution. Prior experience in Exchange Traded Derivatives and Middle Office Operations, including trade capture, trade controls, trade notifications and exception management. Experienced in coordinating with clients, brokers and internal stakeholders to resolve queries and operational issues.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE Regulatory Reporting Associate Ameriprise Financial | Gurugram
Sep 2022 – Apr 2026
Managed end-to-end regulatory reporting activities across MiFID II, Solvency II, PRIIPs, SFDR, MMF and AIFMD



requirements, ensuring accurate, complete and timely reporting. Performed daily and pre-submission validation of regulatory reporting data and outputs to identify missing information, data discrepancies, and reporting exceptions. Supported MiFID II reporting activities, validating underlying transaction/reporting data, and ensuring completeness and accuracy prior to submission. Investigated reporting discrepancies, exceptions and rejected outputs, performed root-cause analysis and coordinated corrective actions through final resolution.
Reviewed regulatory reporting outputs against source data to identify data mismatches, inconsistencies and reporting gaps, working with upstream and downstream teams for remediation.
Managed client-specific regulatory reporting queries and escalations investigated reporting issues and coordinated
resolution with clients, brokers, and internal stakeholders. Provided timely updates on open reporting issues, remediation actions and resolution status, ensuring effective stakeholder communication and closure. Supported UAT and validation of regulatory reporting changes, including test execution, output validation, defect identification, and resolution before production implementation. Supported regulatory change and client-specific reporting initiatives, including impact assessment, requirement analysis, process/control updates, and post-implementation validation. Coordinated with internal teams to ensure timely resolution of reporting queries and delivery of regulatory outputs. Supported quality control checks on regulatory reports before final delivery.
